name: alignment_targets
description: Discover alignment targets from explicit seeds and transitive current authoring/source-scan references. Retains seeds first and dependent feature scene order, suppresses duplicates, excludes raw mesh/point-cloud dependents, and reports locked or unsupported targets and the 32-object limit. Read-only: review entityIds before passing them to alignment_preview/apply. Uses the same operation as Include dependent features in the alignment panel. Native complete controller and all authoring relationship types remain unfinished. Includes sibling outputs of selected active authoring features before dependent discovery; groupIds identifies those siblings. Retained authoring identities and links remain discoverable after baking.

name: object_geometry_digest
description: Read-only cancellable job: inspect stored display, indexed scan and point-cloud numeric carriers with bounded 1 MiB canonical staging instead of exporting large JSON arrays. Returns entityId, units:mm, per-buffer path/encoding/elements/rawBytes/SHA-256/storage/local backing alias IDs and optional point-cloud pose bits. Float32 uses little-endian f32, ordinary number arrays f64, triangle indices u32. Yields between chunks; cancellation or changed project revision discards the result. No geometry/history mutation. Compare path, encoding, counts and hashes; backing IDs are local to one response, not persistent IDs. Poll job_get; cancel through job_cancel.

name: mesh_analyze
description: Explicitly compute full-resolution mesh topology diagnostics in a cancellable worker. Unchanged geometry reuses memory or a persistent content-, tolerance- and algorithm-version-keyed full topology cache across reopening. Result diagnostics.topologyCache reports persistent-hit, memory-hit, stored, unavailable or oversize, with topologyCacheBytes on persistent hits/writes. Selected raw scans up to 262144 facets prepare after render/idle in the background, sharing the GUI 0.001 tolerance index with queued mesh tools. Larger scans prepare on explicit diagnostics or topology-dependent tool requests; invalid or unavailable cached data falls back to analysis.

name: mesh_process
description: Execute scan tools, repair, smooth, reduce, segment, registration, scan editing, selection morphology or section extraction. Source geometry is owned by the workspace. Segmentation objects retain their classifications and fits; responses expose segmentClassifications in segment order. Point clouds support pointCloudEdit deletion, extraction, point-count or voxel simplification, smoothing and radius-connected selection. Whole-cloud paired, ICP and global registration preserve point type and native accumulated pose over immutable local buffers, with bounded CPU transforms; omit selectionOnly for point-cloud registration. Result diagnostics expose pointCloudPose and execution details. Bridge previews reuse prepared source topology without adopting preview geometry; committed bridges retain their successor topology. Hole refinement supports long fixed bridge rails with graded interior density. Inventory reports include holeOrder: closed-boundary indices sorted by descending boundary length, matching the GUI hole list without renumbering geometry references.

sampleInterval.description: Requested sampling spacing in mm; never silently coarsened.

gapFill.description: Maximum attempted gap scale in mm. Zero disables deliberate bridging.

extraThickness.description: Additional outward offset in mm, tapering at local fixed seams.

maxDeviation.description: Captured-surface fitting tolerance in mm, separately measured from sample spacing.

scope.description: Selected excludes hidden triangles. Isolated requires an actual hidden subset and uses visible triangles.

resolution.description: Sampling spacing in mm, default 0.5. Finer spacing preserves smaller details but is not a maximum-deviation tolerance. Reconstruction admits up to 500 million input coordinates and 256 MiB of private numeric transport payload; immutable Float32 shared buffers are borrowed by a disposable worker. This payload limit is not a process memory bound. Surface-local sampling retains one billion grid points, 500 million sampling candidates and sixteen million output triangles; oversized work fails without changing geometry or silently coarsening resolution.

refineSurface.description: Refine a raw indexed moving scan after native coarse registration using targetId. The fixed target may be an indexed scan or exact CAD with cached kernel face triangulations. CAD conversion evaluates analytic D1 positions and normals at cached UV nodes and preserves the BRep. Target records are copied without welding and normals regenerated before refinement. Original landmark vertex seeds grow to 3000 faces or stability. Radius 3 mm. Coarse and delta retain separate Float32 stages.

options.description: Scan section options shared with Create Sketch. selectedOnly uses current original triangle slots; omit top-level selectionOnly or supply the same value.

endBoundary.description: Bridge destination boundary index from inventory, including closed loops and open chains. The indices array identifies exactly one start boundary. Omit to bridge within that same boundary; start/end identify local edge indices. Open paths have pointCount-1 edges.

strength.description: Selected-area smoothing defaults to 0.5; boundary smoothing defaults to 0.3.

iterations.description: Selected-area smoothing defaults to 6 passes; boundary smoothing defaults to 3. Explicit values override these defaults.

neighborRadius.description: Point neighborhood radius in mm; default 0.5.

deviation.description: Maximum cumulative displacement from original sample, mm; default 0.05.

seedVertices.description: Optional original indexed source vertex IDs. Grow a native one-ring region until at least 3000 faces or unchanged count; refine all selected visible region vertices without sampling. Existing selected face flags participate in the stopping count. Whole scan moves.

workerCount.description: Logical native lanes. Preserve this value when comparing serial and parallel output.

parallel.description: Use a bounded two-worker CPU pool when admitted; false evaluates the same logical lanes serially.

targetIds.description: For nativeRefine: ordered fixed indexed mesh targets, ties retain the first. For scanTools/repolygonize or whole-scope shrinkwrap: optional additional aligned visible raw mesh IDs, retained unchanged. Up to 32 distinct IDs, excluding the source; mutually exclusive with targetId.

previewOnly.description: For scanEdit fillHoles mode bridge only: return the generated facet strip as a JSON artifact and continuity diagnostics without changing geometry or history. Requires one start boundary in indices and explicit start/end edge indices; endBoundary optionally selects a different closed loop or open chain. Omit selectionOnly, createNew and targets.

description: Join two straight sketch lines at their analytic infinite-line intersection by trimming or extending selected endpoints. Returns changed, intersection in sketch UV millimetres and shared pointId. General paint trimming, arcs and fillets are separate operations.

Returns changed:true, intersection, ordered tangentPoints, center, radiusMm and arcId; read sketch_get for the exact arc/topology. Splits a shared selected corner ID when needed. Rejects invalid or excessive radius, parallel/degenerate lines, collapsed retained rays, mismatched construction policies, affected constraints, endpoints shared with unrelated primitives and resource exhaustion atomically. Does not infer automatic radius or transfer constraints. Limits:32768 input/output points,8192 input/output curves,4096 constraints,2000000 counted work units including validation.

Circles stored as two arcs are periodic, so their storage seam is not a trim stop. Returns changed, removedCurveIds, retainedCurveIds and intersectionCount. Limits:4096 stroke points,32768 sketch points,4096 constraints,512 stored curves,65536 intersections,8192 output curves,2000000 work units.

description: Read exact CAD face or fitted primitive alignment references without changing geometry or history. Returns paged points, directions and display triangle ranges in mm; exact CAD cylinder faces also expose their kernel radiusMm. Unsupported surfaces are explicit. name: alignment_preview
description: Preview object coordinate alignment from one to three native plane/direction/point constraints. Targets are unlocked meshes, point clouds or exact CAD bodies. Ordered constraints build the reference frame; its rigid inverse transforms scans. Exact CAD uses verified OpenCascade axis-frame placement and retains exact topology. Model/history stay unchanged; preview_discard target datum restores the committed scene and releases temporary CAD handles. Optional translation is in reference-frame axes (mm), not world axes. Constraints may bind reference IDs returned by alignment_references; exact CAD/fitted inputs are read again from the current revision. Large scans use bounded CPU workers when admitted; each target reports execution diagnostics and serial fallback reason. Source-scan references are retained and reported even when stale fitting patches are cleared. Nonidentity CAD placement retains authoringLinks identity and resolved references when clearing its stale recipe. Include dependent recipes and every output of each affected authoring feature; incomplete groups fail before CAD allocation. Identity placement retains the original recipe. Point-cloud alignment retains immutable local buffers and composes the verified double pose; pointCloudPose in each target is its exact little-endian Float64 hex frame. World geometry remains available through object_get. Rendering retains GPU buffers; derived world bounds/views may use bounded CPU workers. Binary project format 3 deduplicates local cloud buffers through history; older format 2 remains readable.

parallel.description: Enable bounded CPU worker execution for large scans (default true); false uses cancellable serial chunks with identical native arithmetic.

name: alignment_apply
description: Apply native coordinate-frame object alignment to unlocked meshes, point clouds or exact CAD bodies as one history transaction. Scan indexed topology and saved selections are preserved; exact CAD uses verified OpenCascade axis-frame placement, retains BRep topology and preserves fitted primitive parameters with verified native transforms and clears stale authoring/display-selection metadata. Same constraints as alignment_preview; source geometry is checked before commit. Cancellation releases temporary CAD outputs; committed source/result handles remain valid for Undo/Redo. Optional translation is in reference-frame axes (mm), not world axes. Constraints may bind reference IDs returned by alignment_references; exact CAD/fitted inputs are read again from the current revision. Large scans use bounded CPU workers when admitted; each target reports execution diagnostics and serial fallback reason. Source-scan references are retained and reported even when stale fitting patches are cleared. Nonidentity CAD placement retains authoringLinks identity and resolved references when clearing its stale recipe. Include dependent recipes and every output of each affected authoring feature; incomplete groups fail before CAD allocation. Identity placement retains the original recipe. Point-cloud alignment retains immutable local buffers and composes the verified double pose; pointCloudPose in each target is its exact little-endian Float64 hex frame. World geometry remains available through object_get. Rendering retains GPU buffers; derived world bounds/views may use bounded CPU workers. Binary project format 3 deduplicates local cloud buffers through history; older format 2 remains readable.

translation.description: Optional X/Y/Z offsets in mm along the constructed reference frame basis, applied before rigid inversion. Defaults to no offset.

translationPoint.description: Optional picked world point in mm. Resolve it in the current source-reference frame and replace translation with those offsets; the picked point becomes the aligned origin.

parallel.description: Enable bounded CPU worker execution for large scans (default true); false uses cancellable serial chunks with identical native arithmetic.

name: landmark_preview
description: Solve the active picked-point session through the GUI preview worker without committing geometry or history. Returns a job; poll job_get. Raw indexed moving scans use native coarse registration, seeded region growth and refinement against indexed scans or exact CAD fixed targets. CAD conversion reuses kernel face triangulations, evaluates analytic D1 positions and normals at their UV nodes, and preserves the BRep. Publishes coarse registration, refinement, diagnostics and markers through landmark_get. Moving point clouds retain their point type, immutable local buffers, normals and composed native double pose; large world-view transforms use at most two CPU workers. Their paired solve sends only picked coordinates to its worker. Cancel through job_cancel or preview_discard targeting landmarks. Refinement uses the session targetScope; visibleScene orders visible evaluated CAD roots before visible indexed scans, excludes superseded CAD inputs using authoring dependency update order, excludes the moving scan, and preserves the fixed geometry. Hidden evaluated consumers still suppress their CAD inputs; exempt construction primitives alone do not. Cyclic authoring dependencies are rejected. With no eligible refinement surfaces, an indexed moving scan retains coarse alignment and native grown selection, reports an accepted identity refinement with the native maximum-float error sentinel, and uses one physical worker without creating a correspondence pool. A successful ordinary preview contains one native matrix and locks repeat preview until landmark_edit action reset; reset retains picked points. This check occurs before CAD resolution or worker allocation.

name: landmark_accept
description: Accept the current picked-point preview through the GUI commit operation. Requires an unchanged, unlocked source and target and a valid preview. Creates one model history step, preserves the fixed target and closes the session. Use a fresh revision and request ID after the preview job completes.

name: landmark_get
description: Read the active picked-point alignment session, original world-coordinate picks, transformed preview markers and preview lock state, with coarse registration, refinement and execution diagnostics when a preview exists. Point-cloud previews also expose pointCloudPose as a little-endian Float64 frame. Also reports optional fixedId (null for all references) and captured referenceIds. Does not mutate geometry or history. Reports canPreview, canReset, canRemove, candidateCount and candidateIndex for the ordinary native single-matrix preview state.

name: landmark_edit
description: Begin or edit the shared picked-point alignment session. Begin requires movingId; fixedId is optional and filters reference picking. With no fixedId, fixed points may come from any visible selectable unlocked reference in the captured scene. reference-target binds fixedId or clears it when omitted, resets picks and preview, and defaults cleared binding to visibleScene. pick requires entityId and a world-coordinate point in mm. Picked coordinates are rounded to native Float32 precision and stored as doubles; values outside the finite Float32 range are rejected. After preview, picking is rejected and removal/clear are no-ops; reset removes the preview and retains original picks. These edits do not create model history. Use landmark_preview to solve, landmark_accept to commit, and preview_discard to close/cancel. Begin defaults to visibleScene refinement against visible evaluated exact CAD roots and other visible indexed scans; fixedId is an optional canvas picking filter. Use targetScope fixed for single-target refinement. action target-scope changes scope and resets preview while retaining picks. landmark_get reports targetScope and refinementTargetIds. Scene geometry/order/visibility changes invalidate a scene-target preview. Point clouds are not mesh-facet refinement targets. Moving clouds use coarse registration and retained native poses. Complete original point-cloud dialog admission and workflow parity remain unverified.

fixedId.description: Optional reference picking filter. Omit at begin for all captured visible references. With action reference-target, omission clears the filter and resets picks and preview.

targetScope.description: Begin defaults to visibleScene: visible exact CAD first, then other visible indexed scans in scene order. fixed preserves single-target refinement. target-scope changes this choice and resets preview while retaining picks.

name: interactive_alignment_get
description: Inspect the active Interactive scan-alignment session: version, Double poses, pivot, measured bounds, drag strength, mirror options, source readiness and worker diagnostics. No geometry transfer.

name: interactive_alignment_edit
description: Begin or edit Interactive alignment for one to 32 unlocked visible mesh/point-cloud scans. Preview uses display poses and leaves authored geometry/history unchanged. Later edits require the latest sessionId and expectedSessionVersion. Strength is percent; step angles are degrees and translations mm; axes are 0=X/1=Y/2=Z. Drag translation/rotation handles use normalized top-left viewport points, including captured points outside the viewport. Mirror is a mesh-only visual reference across XY/YZ/XZ. Apply separately or cancel with preview_discard target interactive.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only for an identical request.

value.description: Step magnitude rounded to finite Float32; positive/negative control determines sign.

handle.description: 1/2/3 translate in YZ/XZ/XY planes; 4/5/6 translate on X/Y/Z axes; 10/11/12 rotate about X/Y/Z.

name: interactive_alignment_apply
description: Apply the active Interactive session once using its latest session/version. Mesh geometry is baked once; point clouds retain their source/Double pose representation. Creates one model-history entry when changed and releases preview resources. Returns a job receipt; inspect job_get. Cancel with preview_discard target interactive.

requestId.description: Unique retry receipt; reuse only for an identical request.

name: scan_preview
description: Preview ShrinkWrap without modifying source or history, compare to the source with sampled surface statistics, accept into history (optionally createNew) or cancel. Create requires operation; later phases require returned previewId and entityId. One disposable preview per editor, expires after 60 seconds; changed source/references or expired worker comparison requires recreation. References and local masks resolve identically to GUI and mesh_process. Compare statistics are sampled, not a certified bound. Revision guards, retry receipts, cancellation and locks apply.

sampleInterval.description: Requested sampling spacing in mm; never silently coarsened.

gapFill.description: Maximum attempted gap scale in mm. Zero disables deliberate bridging.

extraThickness.description: Additional outward offset in mm, tapering at local fixed seams.

maxDeviation.description: Captured-surface fitting tolerance in mm, separately measured from sample spacing.

scope.description: Selected excludes hidden triangles. Isolated requires an actual hidden subset and uses visible triangles.

name: global_alignment_preview
description: Preview Global Fine Align for 2–32 visible unlocked triangle scan meshes already approximately aligned. Uses the shared multicore controller. Defaults to all eligible visible scans in scene order; point clouds and exact CAD are excluded with reasons, partially hidden meshes are rejected. Search tolerance is absolute Float32 mm (default 0.5; zero allowed). Preparation and query memory admission apply. Job returns a cached 60-second preview and per-scan convergence, stability, distance and coverage diagnostics; non-convergence is explicit and does not commit. Use job_get/job_cancel and global_alignment_state; Apply reuses exactly the staged geometry. Outer diagnostics include copied controller poses and ordered application stages as row-major 3x4 matrices with exact Float64 little-endian hex bits (translation in mm).

name: global_alignment_apply
description: Apply an unexpired Global Fine Align preview exactly once as one history step, without recomputing. Requires unchanged source geometry, history, settings and authoring state. Non-converged results may be explicitly applied after inspecting diagnostics. Returns the same staged outer transform receipt, including exact matrix bits and controller-issued application sequence.

name: global_alignment_cancel
description: Cancel preparation or discard the staged Global Fine Align preview and close its panel. Available while its preview job is running; preserves originals and history. Optional jobId scopes automatic cleanup to its owning preparation/preview; a mismatched ID leaves newer work and its panel unchanged. Omit jobId to explicitly cancel the current global preview.

name: global_alignment_state
description: Read Global Fine Align state, preview lease, settings, source IDs, memory/input summary and per-scan convergence diagnostics, plus copied outer poses and controller-issued application stages (row-major 3x4 matrices, Float64 little-endian hex bits, translation in mm).
